text:
Sam: async standup — quick sync on kernel warmup / batching / KV perf. TL;DR: nightly long-seq bench shows ~8% p95 regression. What I did / blockers / today:
- did a short bisect, collected nightly traces
- blocker: can't get slot-level breakdown in dashboard
- today: finish canary rollout + collect flamegraphs

Mirna: bisected too — culprit looks like the slot-accounting tweak from 3 days ago. Repro locally with microburst profile.

Josh: added extra KV eviction logs in a local run. Hitrate drops when microburst occurs, looks correlated to slots being rebalanced. I opened PR #2987 with verbose logs.

Ana: can you dump a flamegraph? would like to see where the CPU spike lands. Run this on the perf node:
```
./bench/run --suite=longseq_p95 --iters=50 --export=flame.svg
```
Also add `--trace=slot` if you want slot tags.

infra-bot: bench job queued: build=2026-02-10-rc2, job_id=b-4123 — <https://ci.redwood/insights/job/b-4123|b-4123>

Mirna: fwiw when I re-enabled prefetch on the canary binary p95 returned to baseline, but CPU went up ~6%. So tradeoff: fewer evictions but higher CPU.

Sam: blocker reminder — need per-model slot allocation in the perf dashboard (so we can see which model triggers rebalances). @Josh can you add a quick trace tag `slot.owner`?

Josh: yep on it. Will push a tiny PR to emit `trace.slot.owner=model_id` at allocation time. Also pinging @Ana for config review on the canary.

Ana: reviewing PR #2988 now. One quick comment: add a microburst seed to the test harness so the bench is deterministic for comparison.

Josh: :thumbsup: will update test and re-run.

Sam: plan for today — finish canary to 50%, run longseq overnight, collect flamegraphs, and merge if green. If regression still present revert the slot-accounting change behind a flag.

Mirna: heads-up I'll be off at 17:00 PT, will watch canary for one hour then hand off notes.

infra-bot: deploy bot: canary deployment started -> 50% shard pool (deploy id d-9001).

Ana: quick Q — proposed rollback thresholds? I suggest: p95 > baseline + 3% OR error_rate > 0.5%. Thoughts?

Sam: good thresholds. also add token-drop metric and kv-evict-rate to the alerting rule.

Mirna: uploading perf viz: <https://dash.redwood/perf/longseq/2026-02-10|longseq run> — has CPU, KV hitrate, eviction spikes.

Josh: if regression persists we'll prepare a patch to restore previous slot accounting behind a feature flag so we can A/B. I can draft that tonight.

Sam: thanks everyone. if anything urgent DM me. leaving final notes here for handoff. /end
